title: US black psychokinesis unit separate from remote viewing programs

tellings.quote: evidence, you know, based on the testimony of some of our top remote viewers that there was a black unit in the United States that was doing these things in the 1970s and 80s. It was separate from the remote viewing programs that were eventually defunded by Congress.

plain: In the 1970s and 80s, a secret, off-the-books US unit is said to have worked on psychokinesis, moving or affecting things with the mind. The philosopher Jason Jorjani says the evidence comes from the testimony of some of the country's top remote viewers, people trained to sense distant places with the mind, and that this unit was kept apart from the remote viewing programs that Congress eventually stopped funding. If true, it would mean the government's mind research went further than the programs the public knows about.
